# Marky v1.8.5

Sync your notes across devices with storage you own, plus a faster way to find
any setting.

### Cloud sync (S3-compatible)

- **Bring your own bucket.** Settings → Cloud sync now talks to any
  S3-compatible service — AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Hetzner — using
  your own endpoint and keys. Your notes go to your bucket and nowhere else.
- **Manual and safe by design.** Nothing leaves your disk until you press
  Sync now. Conflicts resolve last-write-wins per file, and nothing is ever
  deleted on either side — removing a note locally keeps it in the bucket,
  and vice versa.
- **Signed on your device.** Requests are signed locally with your keys
  (SigV4); no third party sees your credentials or your notes.
- **Test before you trust.** Test connection verifies the bucket is reachable
  _and_ writable before your first real sync.

### Settings

- **One section at a time.** The settings page no longer scrolls forever —
  the sidebar swaps sections in place.
- **Search settings.** Type in the new search box ("vim", "minio", "zip"…)
  to jump straight to the right section, even when the word appears nowhere
  in its name.

### Editor polish

- Syntax colors follow the active theme in both light and dark modes, and
  text selection stays readable across themes.
- Sidebar sorting extracted and hardened.
